name: Randomized Littlestone Dimension of Singletons
proof: At each nontrivial node, querying a coordinate separates exactly one remaining singleton from all the others. Querying n-1 distinct coordinates consecutively gives branch-length expectation $\sum_{j=0}^{n-2}2^{-j}=2-2^{2-n}$. Conversely every shattered tree has this comb form with at most n-1 internal nodes on its continuing branch. Dividing by two gives $1-2^{1-n}$.
